summary.headline: Astrological Inceptions
summary.text: Catalog entries for folios 153–158v of a Florentine astrological codex, listing treatises on inceptions: their zodiacal figure, ascendant, luminaries, Sun, Moon, inceptional division, outcomes, and beneficial or harmful indications. The entries include a nine-chapter treatment of inceptions and a passage attributed to Julian quoting Petosiris.
